question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa482f4f17365ab282eb40c17f578e39a1549c6d9c0b80fe7d7b45ce2a1e254.png] 

The percentage increase in the sale of motorcycles in 2020 as compared to that in 2019 is below 15% for the dealer:
solution:
**Given:**

There is the number of motorcycles (in hundred) sold by five dealers during 2019 and 2020 in the given graph.

**Calculation:**

The percentage is as below for all dealers increase in the sale of motorcycles in 2020 as compared to that in 2019.

Dealer A = [(240 - 200)/200] × 100 = (40/200) × 100 = 20%

Dealer B = [(225 - 180)/180] × 100 = (45/180) × 100 = 25%

Dealer C = There is no increase in the sale of motorcycles in 2020 as compared to that in 2019

Dealer D = [(360 - 300)/300] × 100 = (60/300) × 100 = 20%

Dealer E = [(400 - 350)/350] × 100 = (50/350) × 100 = 14.28...%

**∴ The dealer E has the below 15% increase in the sale of motorcycles in 2020 as compared to that in 2019**
